title: HF3570 (2023-2024 Regular): Sale or transfer of semiautomatic military-style assault weapon prohibited, buyback program authorized, and money appropriated.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2024-02-05; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/93/2024/0/HF/3570/versions/0/)
provenance.note: As-filed text, introduced 2024-02-05. The appropriation amounts are blank. Section 1 strikes the sporting-purposes exclusion from the assault-weapon definition.

operative_text:
Section 2 (Minn. Stat. 624.7145, subd. 2): It is unlawful for a person to transfer a semiautomatic military-style assault weapon.
Section 2 (Minn. Stat. 624.7145, subd. 4): A person who violates subdivision 2 is guilty of a felony and may be sentenced to imprisonment for not more than five years or to payment of a fine of not more than $25,000, or both.
Section 3 (uncodified buyback program): The commissioner of public safety shall establish a statewide buyback program to purchase semiautomatic military-style assault weapons. The program must accept any semiautomatic military-style assault weapon offered, regardless of the weapon's physical condition, and pay reimbursement at a rate set by the commissioner.
